summary: Hiker fell down a rock face at the top of the cascading falls upvalley from the Grottos Day Use area. MRA, Aspen Fire and Aspen Ambulance performed a technical rescue; patient extricated and transported by ambulance. Hwy 82 briefly closed. 20 MRA members participated.
location: Top of the cascading falls, upvalley from the Grottos Day Use area off Highway 82 east of Aspen
notes: Likely unfounded report (subject declined aid; companion admitted exaggeration); cf. id 2565 precedent for unfounded reports.
